text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Waaaaaaaaah...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"'Her golden hair flowing! Taking the 
Hanshin JF this year is... the 
breathtakingly beautiful Umamusume, Gold 
City!'"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawaaa... City-san is so cool.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while working hard training for 
the Hanshin JF, we watched footage of a 
race Gold City ran in at Yukino Bijin's 
request.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be like City-san after all. I 
wanna shine so, so bright...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I watch this video, it really 
fires me up to give it my all!
choice_data_list: Looking good! Let's do our best today too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin is full of fighting spirit. 
Meanwhile, the "boom" surrounding her has 
also begun to shift a little—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hello to you too, Trainer♪
choice_data_list: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Curren Chan. Yukino Bijin's 
classmate, and an Umamusume boasting 
immense fame across social media as an 
influencer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Curren-san! Ya need somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren breaking news! Yukino-chan, look at 
this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? My name's under this 'Trending' 
thing...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Yukino-chan is trending on Umatter 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Buzz!? Why?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like her announcing her challenge 
for the Triple Tiara was the trigger."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
They said everyone wants to see 
Yukino-chan wear the tiara.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Curren's looking forward to seeing 
all of your cuteness too, Yukino-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“A country bumpkin might become a real 
princess?! It's a true Cinderella story!”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I don't really get what the Triple Tiara 
is, but it sounds super strong! I'm gonna 
go watch the race!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're flooding in like crazy... So 
this is what it means to go viral.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aya? This article...
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Yukino Bijin, the talk-of-the-town local 
Umamusume. Is the hype around her really 
the real deal?"
choice_data_list: ...Show me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that article, Yukino Bijin was compared 
to a certain "monster" Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap, the "Monster" who came from 
Kasamatsu. As an Umamusume from the 
regional circuit, she drew massive 
attention and built up a record that went 
down in Umamusume history.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the article pointed out that 
Yukino Bijin is different from Oguri Cap. 
It claimed attention was focused solely on 
her looks, and she hadn't gained 
popularity through skill—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"If she walks the Tiara route, her true 
worth will be tested whether she likes it 
or not. Let us quietly observe her 
moves"... huh.
choice_data_list: Yukino—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm completely fine! I'm not feelin' 
down at all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because I haven't produced any real 
results yet. Just as they said, I'm an 
Umamusume whose real battle starts right 
here, yessir.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'll do my best... I'll work 
hard and become the real deal, just like 
Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
That's true.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The results will follow in due time! First 
off, we gotta build up real strength!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yukino, go for it!
choice_data_list: (She really is so positive.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I got class to get to! Catch ya 
later!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...It's only natural that it's still not 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Alright. I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that happened, training 
had been progressing smoothly, but—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...
choice_data_list: Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, y-yeth, I'm... okay...!
choice_data_list: Are you... looking really exhausted?
Are you... looking really exhausted?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ahehh, that's true... Looks like I pushed 
myself a bit too hard in training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, the training shouldn't have left 
this much lingering fatigue. In fact, the 
exact same routine caused no issues 
before."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, I'm really okay, so...
choice_data_list: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...'Scuse me. I just can't seem to shake 
the fatigue from my late-night training.
choice_data_list: Were you doing extra training on your own?
Were you doing extra training on your own?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mountain trail marathons, log weight 
training, and sprint dashes up the slopes 
to the absolute limit...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even though people are talking about me, 
with how I am right now, it's not reaching 
them.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I got so impatient thinking I had to build 
up my skills right away...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I could ever really become a 
"City Girl" like that.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The results will follow in due time! First 
off, we gotta build up real strength!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her positivity is the real deal. Yet, she 
always seemed so insecure about her own 
abilities.
choice_data_list: (So I ended up trying way too hard.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Um, was that no good?
choice_data_list:
Self-training isn't a bad thing, it's 
just...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The training menu is designed keeping the 
whole picture in mind. If we add more on 
top of this, you'll end up overworking 
yourself.
choice_data_list:
I want us to think through the parts 
you're worried about together.

Let's think through the parts you're 
worried about together.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"That's not true at all! After all, 
Yuki-chan wasn't the only one who made the 
decision, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer decided that we could do it, 
right? Then everything's gonna be fine!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right... That was it. Yukino~, you 
silly horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even though I should have consulted 
Trainer about it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I got ahead of myself all alone... To 
think I made you worry like that.
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry I didn't notice how anxious you 
were, either.

I'm sorry I didn't notice your anxiety, 
either.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hyaa! Please don't apologize, yer honor!
choice_data_list: Still, there's no need to rush.
Still, there's no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
If you keep at it steadily, you'll 
definitely be fine.

If you keep at it steadily, you'll 
definitely be fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By now, I'm certain of Yukino Bijin's 
potential. No matter the race, no matter 
the opponent, she's sure to deliver 
splendid results.
choice_data_list:
If it's you, you can make this boom real 
with your running!

If it's you, you can make that boom real 
with your running!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wah. ...
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I just remembered. About what happened 
back in the village..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who praised my running so much, 
and believed that I'd be okay.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so happy and grateful... It really 
touched my heart."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I feel the exact same way right now. We 
can't go losing our confidence, can we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, suddenly building confidence or 
clearing away anxiety won't be easy. I 
want to encourage her a bit more, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Even Mifuyu-chan said it would be fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Mifuyu"—Yukino Bijin's best friend. I 
exchanged contact info with her when I 
invited her to Tokyo to cheer on Yukino 
before her debut.
choice_data_list: (So it's Mifuyu-san...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words carry great power for Yukino 
Bijin. How wonderful it would be if she 
could have her encouragement close by.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That night, I contacted Mifuyu-san to ask 
if she could come over here to watch the 
Hanshin JF.
